title: Inspection Rework Loop Detector
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:inspection
| stats sum(eval(if(result="failed",1,0))) as failures, sum(eval(if(rework_required="yes",1,0))) as reworks by inspection_type
| sort - reworks
description: Finds inspection types that repeatedly fail and spin work back into rework loops.
value: A rework loop burns both money and morale; spotting the repeating inspection failure points is high leverage.
implementation: Ingest inspection outcomes and rework flags in `reno:inspection`; rank inspection types by rework count.
visualization: Table of inspection types with failure and rework counts.
grandmaExplanation: It maps where inspections keep failing and forcing the same kind of do-over work.
